posts.text: ADHD burnout in women is mislabeled as anxiety—every. single. time.
Some days the win is just showing up. That counts.
ADHD recovery isn’t perfection—it’s self-compassion in motion.
My ADHD brain treats every idea like an emergency so I made peace with my process.
ADHD gives me 1,000 unfinished ideas and one masterpiece. This hit.
If I had a dollar for every time I said ‘I’ll start tomorrow,’ I’d be rich enough to hire an assistant to remind me tomorrow.
